status: DRAFT: written from standard dermoscopy criteria, needs clinician review
state_after_gate: An image is attached. It is a dermoscopy image of one skin lesion.

gate.q: Is this a close-up image of human skin?
Is there a single skin lesion near the centre of the image?
Is the lesion in sharp focus?
Does the image show a magnified view with fine surface structures visible, as in dermoscopy?
Is more than half of the lesion hidden by hair, a ruler, a marker or an air bubble?

features.q: Is the outline of the lesion irregular, with notches or uneven edges?
Are the two halves of the lesion clearly different in shape or colour?
Does the lesion show three or more distinct colours?
Does the lesion contain a black or very dark brown area?
Does the lesion contain a blue, grey or white area?
Does the lesion contain red or pink areas?
Is a regular network of fine brown lines visible across the lesion?
Are branching blood vessels visible on the lesion?
Does the lesion look like a waxy, raised patch that appears stuck onto the skin?
Are small round white or yellow cyst-like spots or openings visible?
Are dots or globules scattered unevenly across the lesion?
Is the colour spread evenly across the whole lesion?
Is part of the lesion surface ulcerated, crusted or bleeding?
Is the border of the lesion sharply and smoothly separated from the surrounding skin?
Does the lesion contain a pearly or translucent area?

discriminators.q: Is there a milky blue-white haze over part of the lesion?
Are there irregular streaks or finger-like projections at the edge of the lesion?
Are there scar-like white areas or grey-blue peppering inside the lesion?
Is the network of brown lines thick and irregular, with abrupt endings?
Is the pigment arranged in a regular, symmetric pattern around the centre?
Are there several dots or globules of the same size, evenly spaced?
Are tree-like branching vessels with thick trunks visible?
Are rounded blue-grey nests or large blue-grey areas visible?
Are there leaf-like or spoke-wheel shaped brown areas?
Is there a shiny, rolled border around part of the lesion?
Are there several round or oval cream-coloured cyst-like structures?
Are there dark plug-like openings on the surface?
Does the surface show a brain-like or fingerprint-like pattern of ridges?
Does the border look moth-eaten or scalloped with a sharp edge?
